title: Warm permission does not remove feelings

captions.physics: Directly confirming readiness to hear discomfort
captions.energy: Upholding an accepted value of respect

meaning: You can directly confirm readiness to hear something uncomfortable and rely on an accepted value of respect, noticing dependence on guaranteed calm that genuine agreement to talk does not require.
text: On your Vishuddha, the Sun in the physical position appears in direct warm confirmation of readiness to listen. The Hierophant in energy supports an accepted value of respectful words and taking agreement seriously. The Devil in emotions brings dependence on guaranteed calm. You can want an honest exchange while especially needing a promise that nothing said will hurt. This pull does not make possible disappointment a breach of agreement.

For example, “Can I say something unpleasant?” receives a friendly “Yes, I am ready to hear it”. Yet another confirmation is wanted: “I definitely will not be upset”. **Readiness to listen does not guarantee no disappointment**. You can distinguish accepted agreement from wanted protection against every consequence. A warm answer remains genuine even if the next remark prompts a difficult feeling. Respectful listening promises no tolerance of every manner of address; particular readiness leaves room to name what hurt in a tone.

Difficulty grows if no willingness to listen counts without an impossible guarantee. Significant words lose weight beside a formula of complete calm. The constructive Hierophant helps return to an accepted meaning of respect with room for honest feeling. You can hear the answer seriously and acknowledge wanting protection; participation is not measured by absent unpleasant feelings, while promising care does not oblige forever excluding every frustration or question.
